Question: What is the average review score for orders that contain more than one item?
text:

FROM (
  SELECT order_id
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) oi
JOIN order_reviews ore ON oi.order_id = ore.order_id;
